title: Underground theatre
content: Had a dream just a few minutes ago. Was in a mall looking place except theres like beds and rooms people could sleep in at the top floor of the building. One of these rooms are paid for exclusively to sleep in to meditate or something spiritual but its known to be haunted if u mess up a ritual there things could go bad. A girl took me there her face looks familiar yet unfamiliar. Shes got this algerian vibe. When we were there she told me to get candles so the ritual wouldnt get messed up. I ended up in a cafetaria when i couldnt find one hoping they would somehow give me some which is pretty weird. On the way back i got lost and just followed these stairs which quickly turned into a wide yet shallow hall, its made out of black bricks, white dim lights and some sort of ventilation system above which u can easily hit ur head on. It led to a huge theatre which is the same theme as the hall i described and it seems like somehow it was built from a bunch of abandoned clothing stores combined cause there are clothing racks everywhere except on the stage.
